users.step1_content: You can add new admins or editors to help manage the content.
users.step2_content: Here you can browse all registered users, edit their permissions, or remove them.
users.step3_content: The system supports different access levels: (Admin) for full control, (Editor) for content only, and (Viewer) for read-only access.

snippets.step1_content: Create ready-made content pieces (Snippets) to reuse across different pages.
snippets.step2_content: Here you can find all the code or design pieces you've saved for reuse.
snippets.step3_content: You can edit the component via code as HTML or visually using drag and drop.

activity.step1_content: Monitor all operations in the dashboard to maintain data security and integrity.

dashboard.step1_content: Here you can view quick statistics about your website and pages.
dashboard.step2_content: From here you can control website settings, logo, and colors.
dashboard.step3_content: Create new pages and edit their content with ease.
dashboard.step4_content: Use ready-made components to build your pages quickly and professionally.

editor.step1_content: Drag components from here and drop them into the design area to build your page.
editor.step2_content: Here you can preview the page live, and click on any element to edit or delete it.
editor.step3_content: From here you can control page settings, logo, and colors.
editor.step4_content: After finishing the design, don't forget to save changes to update the website.

footers.step1_content: Customize the bottom part of your website (Footer) and add important links and information.
footers.step2_content: Browse the templates used at the bottom of the site and edit their content.

menus.step1_content: Create navigation menus to organize your website links.
menus.step2_content: From here you can add links to the menu, arrange them, and determine where they appear on the site.

pages.step1_content: Start by adding new pages to your site such as (Contact Us, Privacy Policy, etc.).
pages.step2_content: Here you can see all pages, their status (published or draft), and the link for each.
pages.step3_content: This icon opens the easy page designer to build page content with drag and drop.

searchReplace.step1_content: You can change specific text across the entire site with one click, useful for updating links or recurring names.

social.step1_content: Add links to the organization's social media accounts to appear on the site.
social.step2_content: Control added accounts, edit links, or hide specific platforms.

websites.step1_content: Click here to start the process of creating a new website for a charity or other entity.
websites.step2_content: Here all the websites you created appear, you can edit or delete them from the actions section.
